overviews.name: VSAMMQ
key_points: Answers two kinds of inquiry that arrive as MQ request messages: account details (transaction CDRA, program COACCT01) and the system date and time (transaction CDRD, program CODATE01).
Read-only towards the card data: the only application file it touches is the account master, CICS file ACCTDAT, read by account id; its outputs are MQ reply and error messages.

descriptions.name: COACCT01
descriptions.description: CICS program of transaction CDRA: takes account-inquiry requests off an MQ queue, reads the account from CICS file ACCTDAT and puts the account details on a reply queue.
key_points: Opens error queue CARD.DEMO.ERROR, takes the request queue name from the MQ trigger message (EXEC CICS RETRIEVE INTO(MQTM)) and replies on CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT.
Per request with function INQA and a non-zero 11-digit key it reads ACCTDAT by account id and replies with status, balance, limits, dates, cycle credit/debit and group id.
A missing account or a wrong function gets an INVALID REQUEST PARAMETERS reply; it syncpoints per message, loops until MQGET (5 s wait) reports no message, then closes the queues and returns.

descriptions.name: CODATE01
descriptions.description: CICS program of transaction CDRD: takes requests off an MQ queue and replies with the CICS system date and time on a reply queue.
key_points: Opens error queue CARD.DEMO.ERROR, takes the request queue name from the MQ trigger message (EXEC CICS RETRIEVE INTO(MQTM)) and replies on CARD.DEMO.REPLY.DATE.
For every request message, whatever its content, it runs ASKTIME/FORMATTIME and puts 'SYSTEM DATE : mm-dd-yyyy SYSTEM TIME : hh:mm:ss' on the reply queue.
It syncpoints per message and loops until MQGET reports no message available, then closes the queues and returns.
